notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Changes
Refill button bug

The bug where water would refill over the dock with the refill button in the shop has been fixed. If you have a bugged save in this way, clicking the refill button should set your water to the correct position.

Added 1 cat

notes.title: Fishing Fest Update
notes.notes:
Major Changes
Tutorial

The demo wall has been moved further out, granting access to more content
Polish Features
New art for dock cards

Art improvements for the dock

Environmental art improvements

Improved fish visuals

Straw Length upgrade unlocked

Speed Up upgrade unlocked

More particles

Fish sipping looks better

Chests can no longer be opened while completely submerged in water

Bug fixes

More!

We recommend resetting your save to get the full new and improved Sip Fisher experience, though you can always just start where you left off!



The team wants to thank everyone who has left a review on our demo. Your feedback has been crucial in making Sip Fisher better! We will be continuing to fix bugs in the demo until our full release!
